newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BEERS SEES LOWER 1997 H1 NET.
newsitem.headline: BEERS SEES LOWER 1997 H1 NET.

text.p: Auto dealer Beers said on Friday that first-half 1997 profits were expected to lag behind those of the same year-earlier period.
"The result over the first half of 1997 is expected to be lower than the result in the same period of 1996, a record year," the company said in a statement.
It said it had delivered fewer trucks in the first few months of 1997 than in the period a year earlier which resulted in the expectation that profits would fall year-on-year.
The total number of new registrations in the heavy goods vehicles market was also down 16.3 percent from last year's high levels, Beers added.
